Its partial transpose has eigenvalues $1$ and $3-4p$, so $\|A^\Gamma\|_\infty\le1$. For every Rains-feasible $\tau$, $\operatorname{Tr}A\tau\le\|A^\Gamma\|_\infty\|\tau^\Gamma\|_1\le1=\operatorname{Tr}A\sigma$. This is the convex first-order optimality condition. It also holds for tensor powers. Since $\sigma^{\otimes n}$ is PPT, both regularized PPT relative entropy and the Rains value equal $1-h_2(p)$ here.
